item.title: Know Your Enemy: Leaving MAGA Behind - Dissent Magazine
item.description: Matt and Sam talk to writer Pedro L. Gonzalez about his break with MAGA and the New Right.

item.title: A New Vision for Public Lands - Dissent Magazine
item.description: Policy debates around public lands point to larger unresolved questions about the nature and function of the public trust. What should we do with this national resource at a moment of major transition?

item.title: A Tale of Two Plumbers - Dissent Magazine
item.description: Hannah Spencer's victory in a UK parliamentary by-election is a major win for the Green Party, which aims to build a viable left-populist alternative to Reform UK and Keir Starmer's Labour Party.

item.title: Response to “The Conquerors of Tomorrow” - Dissent Magazine
Could Democrats Regain the Rural Vote? - Dissent Magazine
item.description: The end of the twentieth century left rural America shell-shocked, and residents reacted accordingly.

item.title: Know Your Enemy: Trump's War Against Iran - Dissent Magazine
item.description: Matt and Sam talk to Matt Duss, a leading foreign policy expert on the left, about the U.S. and Israeli war against Iran.

item.title: War, Revolt, and Iran's Unfinished Struggle - Dissent Magazine
item.description: The protests and repression that preceded the U.S.–Israeli bombing campaign exposed both the fragility of the Iranian governing elite and the organizational weakness of Iranian civil society—dynamics that will continue to shape the country in the months to come.

item.title: City Limits - Dissent Magazine
item.description: Anne Hidalgo’s mayoralty illustrates the limits of local responses to national and international problems like housing and climate change. Without wider coordination, even the most successful mayor’s reach can only extend so far.

item.title: Trump's War - Dissent Magazine
item.description: The fact that the war in Iran has proven so shocking to both Trump's base and the broader commentariat reflects how distorted the popular view of Trump and MAGA has become.

item.title: Know Your Enemy: From Neocon to Never-Trump - Dissent Magazine
item.description: Matt and Sam talk to Bill Kristol about his journey from neoconservative thought leader to anti-Trump liberal.
